event.purpose: BB84 explicit-bases protected authored controls; not model scoring

hard/qiskitHumanEval/63.domain: Ideal independent BB84 preparations with explicit binary bases, n >= 1
limitations: Nine fixed authored cases are not exhaustive or independently certified
Noisy, measured, malformed and entangled input circuits are out of scope
Graph transport and Qiskit runtime still require separate validation
hard/qiskitHumanEval/63.public_contract: Inputs are equal-length binary sequences senders_basis and receivers_basis, and an unmeasured n-qubit QuantumCircuit circuit, with n >= 1. The circuit prepares independent ideal BB84 states: sender bit 0 or 1 is encoded in the sender's Z basis (0) or X basis (1) on each qubit. Return a Python string of the measured bits at positions where sender and receiver bases match, in ascending qubit-index order; discard all other positions. For these ideal inputs the retained bits are deterministic. Use the supplied receivers_basis; do not choose receiver bases.
